ryans.name: Ryan Carniato
ryans.title: Software engineer; creator of the SolidJS JavaScript UI library and a proponent of fine-grained reactivity (signals)
ryans.lead_summary: **Ryan Carniato** is a software engineer and the creator of SolidJS, an open-source JavaScript library for building user interfaces [1][2]. The project's GitHub repository was created in April 2018 and describes Solid as "a declarative, efficient, and flexible JavaScript library for building user interfaces" [1]. Since September 2024 he has worked at Sentry as a Staff engineer on its open-source team, a role that funds his full-time work on Solid [3][4].
known_for: Advocacy for signals and fine-grained reactivity in front-end frameworks
